# Personal Attributes API endpoints
{: .no_toc}

Personal attributes are the lab's own resources: setups, inventories, behavioral assays, data storage, licenses and protocols. They are shared with groups rather than projects, and each has invitation endpoints for members and groups.

## Resources

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`setup`](/api/personal_attributes/setup/) | A physical rig, maze or apparatus in the lab, with the equipment installed in it. | private, public |
| [`inventory`](/api/personal_attributes/inventory/) | A place where the lab keeps track of its consumable stock. | private, public |
| [`behavioralassay`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/) | The lab's own implementation of a behavioral paradigm: how the task is actually run. | private, public |
| [`datastorage`](/api/personal_attributes/datastorage/) | Where session data lives, how it can be reached and how it is organized. | private, public |
| [`license`](/api/personal_attributes/license/) | A regulatory authorization the lab works under, such as an animal research approval. | private, public |
| [`protocol`](/api/personal_attributes/protocol/) | A written method the lab reuses, such as a standard operating procedure. | private, public |

## Supporting endpoints

Approval requests, membership invitations and link tables. Most workflows never call these directly; the main resources create and resolve them.

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`behavioralassaygroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassaygroupmembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for groups to join a behavioral assay. When any user in the group accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |
| [`behavioralassaymembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassaymembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for members to join a behavioral assay. When the user accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |
| [`datastoragegroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/datastoragegroupmembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for groups to join a data storage. When any user in the group accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |
| [`datastoragemembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/datastoragemembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for members to join a data storage. When the user accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |
| [`inventorygroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/inventorygroupmembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for groups to join an inventory. When any user in the group accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |
| [`inventorymembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/inventorymembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for members to join an inventory. When the user accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |
| [`licensegroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/licensegroupmembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for groups to join a license. When any user in the group accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |
| [`licensemembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/licensemembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for members to join a license. When the user accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |
| [`protocolgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/protocolgroupmembershipinvitation/) | Protocol group membership invitation records. | private |
| [`protocolmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/protocolmembershipinvitation/) | Protocol membership invitation records. | private |
| [`setupgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/setupgroupmembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for groups to join a data storage. When any user in the group accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |
| [`setupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/setupmembershipinvitation/) | Table to store invitations for members to join a data storage. When the user accepts / rejects the invitation, this record will be deleted. | private |

All endpoints follow `https://www.brainstem.org/api/{portal}/personal_attributes/{resource}/` and support the common [query parameters](/api/#query-parameters).
